prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 84.5%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 90.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 80.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 83.6%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 71.7%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 36.7%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Orientation Module Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive orientation screen before the final completion screen to teach users how to summon, move, hide, and talk to their desktop pet. (why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion on controlling or hiding the pet, and 28.3% drop off between home and finish steps.)
1: [choose_path, redesign] Centered Journey Pathways Redesign: Redesigns the path choice screen into a centered layout with distinct card visualizers for adopting standard presets vs generating custom pets. (why: The choose_path screen has an 84.5% conversion with a high mean time of 514s, indicating confusion or decision inertia.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Quality Assistant Flow: Adds a new validation step during photo upload that checks image clarity and gives live feedback prior to pet rendering. (why: 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failures or unexpected visual output, contributing to the long 1017s mean duration in adoption.)
3: [home, redesign] Centered Stage Waiting Experience Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen into a stage layout showing live status stages as the desktop pet assets are generated. (why: The waiting/home phase exhibits a huge mean duration of 2336s, and 3 support emails reported pet spawning or launch stalls.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Restore Verification Hint: Adds explicit sign-in hint text reassuring returning users that signing in restores all previous pet profiles automatically. (why: 8 support emails (the single largest issue) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in.)
5: [adoption, copy] Certificate Name Entry Guidance Copy: Updates the adoption certificate copy to clarify that naming the pet is quick and can be modified anytime in settings later. (why: Adoption step drops conversion to 80.2% with 89s median / 1017s mean time spent.)
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Troubleshooter Wait Info: Adds a troubleshooting hint and timer delay on the waiting screen for users experiencing slow desktop spawning. (why: 3 users reported desktop pet visibility bugs or app launch stalls during the waiting step.)
7: [finish, notification] System Tray Quick Hide Notification Switch: Enables a system ready notification toggle on home intro along with instructions on using the system tray icon to control pet visibility. (why: 3 support tickets noted confusion around hiding or revealing the pet once onboarding finishes.)
8: [sign_in, layout] Compact Layout for Sign In Screen: Switches the sign-in step to a compact layout to minimize layout shifts and streamline authentication. (why: 2 support tickets mentioned sign-in screen stalling or failing to show, and sign_in mean duration is high at 567s.)
